en.quote: …that means losing an hour of sleep, but after that the problems will be over.
en.head: The clocks were turned back.
en.body: Medvedev announced that in spring 2011 the clocks would be changed for the last time and the country would remain on summer time. But on July 22, 2014, Putin signed a law restoring standard time from October 26. In February 2013, Medvedev had proposed keeping the arrangement.

notes: The source quote begins mid-sentence, marked by an ellipsis in Russian; retain it. Terminology edited: “standard time” is the natural English equivalent in this context for Russia’s return from permanent summer time; “winter time” would sound literal and unclear.
